rationale: The final three 1-minute candles recovered from the 10.51 low with successively higher closes and the latest candle exploding to 453k shares (roughly 4-5× prior candles) while tagging the session high at 10.60. Price has stabilized above both session VWAP and 9-EMA at 10.56 while the broad market is fractionally green and VIX futures are lower; this combination shows aggressive buyer absorption after the gap-down open. A break below the 10.51 area would invalidate the intraday demand thesis.
